sloka: हत्वा तु समरे क्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम् ।राघवौ त्वां विशालाक्षि स्वां पुरीं प्रापयिष्यतः ।। ५.४०.१६।।।।
transliteration: hatvā tu samare krūraṁ rāvaṇaṁ sahabāndhavam ।rāghavau tvāṁ viśālākṣi svāṁ purīṁ prāpayiṣyataḥ ।। 5.40.16।।।।

translations.english: "O largeeyed lady Killing in war the vile Ravana, the demon king and all his relatives, Rama would take you back to his own city৷৷
